{{Top|leg}}
'''Second Mistake''' was a slab of [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] 'art' containing the [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] [[Grees]]. [[Jenet/Legends|Jenet]] criminal [[Ludlo Lebauer]] had him frozen inside when Grees, [[Emala]], and [[Sligh]], refused to be cut out as middle-beings and out their contacts. With the help of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]], Grees was freed and Ludlo lost his favorite piece of art.
